articles.title: Arrow Exploration CEO on Icaco success, record production and next drilling targets
articles.summary:
Arrow Exploration Corp (TSX-V:AXL, AIM:AXL, OTC:CSTPF) CEO Marshall Abbott talked with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about the company's latest drilling success at Icaco in Colombia, where the IC-HZ9 well has exceeded production expectations and helped lift corporate output above 7,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day.

Abbott highlighted the well's strong performance and reserves potential, explaining how a specialist monobore design with cemented casing and targeted perforations is helping optimise production.

Although initial output reached around 3,000 barrels per day, Arrow is managing flow rates to maximise ultimate reservoir recovery rather than short-term production.

Looking ahead, the company has identified six additional drilling locations at Icaco, while the recently spudded IC-HZ10 is targeting the Ubaque formation. Abbott outlined the potential for further reserves growth and rapid well payback under Colombia's fiscal regime.

The interview also covers Arrow's cash position of more than US$35 million and progress towards securing an extension to the Tapir block contract, a key priority for its longer-term growth plans.
